LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASS: PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we tell others exactly where people and things are? 2. How do we show the position of people and things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify prepositions of position and direction in sentences,
2. use prepositions correctly in oral and written contexts,
3. promote the use of prepositions for clarity in communication. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: construct sentences using prepositions,

5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should we tell others exactly where people and things are? 2. How do we show the position of people and things?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
